title: 15th Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 10/3/2026 to 12/3/2026).

Bills to be introduced: first reading of the Death Penalty Enforcement Bill (on setting and carrying out the death penalty), submitted on behalf of the government by Guraidhoo MP Hanan Mohamed Rasheed.
First reading of the Right to Protection of Name and Reputation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Vilimale' MP Mohamed Ismail.
First reading of the Maldives Immigration Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by North Kulhudhuffushi MP Mohamed Dawoodh.
First reading of the Real Estate Business Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by North Henveyru MP Ahmed Aifan.
Debate on the proposed 2027 State Budget, held under Article 235 of the Parliament's Rules of Procedure.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This sitting was set to introduce four government bills (death penalty enforcement, name and reputation, immigration, real estate) and debate the 2027 State Budget.
